facts.text: Maria expressed admiration for the architecture in London and wanted to recreate its charm in her own space.

evidence.quote: It was in London. The architecture there was so captivating that I wanted to recreate some of that charm in my own space.
I got the idea from that trip to England a few years ago - I was mesmerized by the castles. I wanted to bring that same magic to my home, like a reminder of the world's beauty.

facts.text: John mentioned that he retook an aptitude test and achieved great results, which made him feel drawn to serving his country.

evidence.quote: Last week I retook the aptitude test with some great results, and I feel drawn to serving my country in this way.

facts.text: John discussed his decision to serve his country with his family and friends, who were supportive of his choice.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I chatted with my family and friends about it. They've been supportive and understand why I want to volunteer.

facts.text: Maria mentioned that she has a support system and is making a positive impact at the homeless shelter through her volunteer work.

evidence.quote: Glad you have a good support system, John. It's been great having people behind me while volunteering at the homeless shelter. Positive influences make a big impact.
